title: Why Do Middle and High Schoolers Miss School? Selected Findings from the American Youth Panel and the American Parents Panel
summary_en: Using data from two surveys administered in late 2025 to nationally representative samples of students and parents, the authors investigate why secondary school-age students are missing school and to what extent these reasons differ by age.
title_cn: Why Do Middle and High Schoolers Miss School? Selected Findings from the American Youth Panel and the American Parents Panel

title: The RAND School Is Rethinking Higher Ed: Q&A with Nancy Staudt
summary_en: Nancy Staudt is leading the RAND School of Public Policy at a moment when higher education is being pushed to evolve in a world defined by constant change.
title_cn: The RAND School Is Rethinking Higher Ed: Q&A with Nancy Staudt

title: Verifiable Audit Trails for AI-Enabled Biological Design Tools: A Proposal for Verifiable Biodesign Logging
summary_en: The authors propose a tamper-evident audit-trail framework using cryptographic signing to establish a trustworthy chain of custody that can be used with any artificial intelligence–enabled biological design tool.
title_cn: Verifiable Audit Trails for AI-Enabled Biological Design Tools: A Proposal for Verifiable Biodesign Logging
